mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO campaign_delivery (workspace_id, send_id, person_id, address, status, unsubscribe_token) VALUES
(#{workspaceId}, #{delivery.sendId}, #{delivery.personId}, #{delivery.address}, #{delivery.status}, #{delivery.unsubscribeToken})
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS delivery_id, d.send_id, s.channel, d.person_id, d.status, d.skip_reason, d.reconciliation_required_at, d.last_error_code AS reason_code, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id
ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id
mapper.sql: FROM campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id JOIN campaign c ON c.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND c.id = s.campaign_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.person_id = #{personId}
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id AS delivery_id, c.id AS campaign_id, c.name AS campaign_name, d.send_id, s.channel, d.status, d.created_at, d.updated_at
ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM campaign_delivery WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT id, workspace_id, send_id, person_id, frequency_reserved_at, attempt_count, last_error, last_error_code, reconciliation_required_at FROM campaign_delivery WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM campaign_delivery WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND send_id = #{sendId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM campaign_delivery WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND send_id = #{sendId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_delivery WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND send_id = #{sendId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'dispatching', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id SET d.status = 'dispatching', d.attempt_count = d.attempt_count + 1, d.provider_id = #{providerId}, d.attempt_target_fingerprint = #{attemptTargetFingerprint}, d.dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, d.dispatch_lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseMicros} MICROSECOND) WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{id} AND d.status = 'pending' AND (d.attempt_target_fingerprint IS NULL OR d.attempt_target_fingerprint = #{attemptTargetFingerprint}) AND s.origin = 'triggered' AND s.status = 'triggered'

UPDATE campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id SET d.status = 'failed', d.skip_reason = NULL, d.last_error = #{lastError}, d.last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, d.reconciliation_required_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), d.reconciliation_outcome = NULL WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{id} AND d.status = 'pending' AND d.attempt_target_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND d.attempt_target_fingerprint <> #{attemptTargetFingerprint} AND s.origin = 'triggered' AND s.status = 'triggered'

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET dispatch_lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseMicros} MICROSECOND) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching' AND dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND dispatch_lease_until >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.sql: (attempt_count = 1 OR (last_error_code IS NULL AND last_error = 'Claim released before provider egress'))
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'pending', provider_id = NULL, attempt_target_fingerprint = CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE attempt_target_fingerprint END, last_error_code = CASE WHEN THEN NULL ELSE 'deadline_ambiguous' END, last_error = CASE WHEN THEN 'Claim released before provider egress' ELSE last_error END, frequency_reserved_at = #{priorFrequencyReservedAt}, dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching' AND dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.provider_id, d.attempt_target_fingerprint, s.channel FROM campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.status = 'dispatching' AND d.dispatch_lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND s.origin = 'triggered' AND s.status = 'triggered' ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id SET d.status = 'pending', d.last_error_code = 'deadline_ambiguous', d.dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, d.dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{id} AND d.status = 'dispatching' AND d.dispatch_lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND d.attempt_target_fingerprint = #{attemptTargetFingerprint} AND s.origin = 'triggered' AND s.status = 'triggered'

UPDATE campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id SET d.status = 'failed', d.skip_reason = NULL, d.last_error = #{lastError}, d.last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, d.reconciliation_required_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), d.reconciliation_outcome = NULL, d.dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, d.dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{id} AND d.status = 'dispatching' AND d.dispatch_lease_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND s.origin = 'triggered' AND s.status = 'triggered'
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.send_id FROM campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.status = 'dispatching' AND d.dispatch_lease_owner IS NULL AND d.submitted_at IS NULL AND d.frequency_reserved_at IS NOT NULL AND d.frequency_reserved_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{graceMicros} MICROSECOND) AND s.origin = 'audience' ORDER BY d.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id SET d.status = 'failed', d.skip_reason = NULL, d.last_error = #{lastError}, d.last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, d.reconciliation_required_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), d.reconciliation_outcome = NULL WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{id} AND d.status = 'dispatching' AND d.dispatch_lease_owner IS NULL AND d.submitted_at IS NULL AND d.frequency_reserved_at IS NOT NULL AND d.frequency_reserved_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{graceMicros} MICROSECOND) AND s.origin = 'audience'

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'dispatched', skip_reason = NULL, provider_id = #{providerId}, provider_message_id = #{providerMessageId}, last_error = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, reconciliation_required_at = NULL, submitted_at = COALESCE(submitted_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching'

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'dispatched', skip_reason = NULL, provider_id = #{providerId}, provider_message_id = #{providerMessageId}, last_error = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, reconciliation_required_at = NULL, submitted_at = COALESCE(submitted_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching' AND dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'skipped', skip_reason = #{skipReason}, last_error_code = NULL, reconciliation_required_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching'

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'skipped', skip_reason = #{skipReason}, last_error_code = NULL, reconciliation_required_at = NULL, dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching' AND dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'failed', skip_reason = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching' AND reconciliation_required_at IS NULL

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'failed', skip_reason = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching' AND dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND reconciliation_required_at IS NULL

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'failed', skip_reason = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, reconciliation_required_at = COALESCE(reconciliation_required_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), reconciliation_outcome = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching'

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET status = 'failed', skip_reason = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, reconciliation_required_at = COALESCE(reconciliation_required_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), reconciliation_outcome = NULL, dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'dispatching' AND dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}

UPDATE campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id SET d.status = #{toStatus}, d.skip_reason = NULL, d.last_error = #{lastError}, d.last_error_code = NULL, d.reconciliation_required_at = NULL, d.reconciliation_outcome = #{outcome}, d.submitted_at = CASE WHEN #{outcome} = 'operator_delivered' THEN COALESCE(d.submitted_at, LEAST(d.frequency_reserved_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), d.created_at) ELSE d.submitted_at END, d.frequency_reserved_at = CASE WHEN #{outcome} = 'operator_not_delivered' THEN NULL ELSE d.frequency_reserved_at END, d.dispatch_lease_owner = NULL, d.dispatch_lease_until = NULL WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{id} AND s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND d.status = 'failed' AND d.reconciliation_required_at IS NOT NULL AND d.reconciliation_outcome IS NULL

UPDATE campaign_delivery d JOIN campaign_send s ON s.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND s.id = d.send_id SET d.frequency_reserved_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{reservationMicros} MICROSECOND) WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = #{deliveryId} AND d.person_id = #{personId} AND s.channel = #{channel} AND d.status = 'dispatching' AND d.submitted_at IS NULL AND s.status IN ('queued', 'running', 'triggered')
AND s.origin = 'triggered' AND s.status = 'triggered' AND d.dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND d.dispatch_lease_until >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
AND s.origin = 'audience' AND d.dispatch_lease_owner IS NULL

UPDATE campaign_delivery SET frequency_reserved_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{deliveryId} AND status = 'dispatching' AND submitted_at IS NULL AND AND reconciliation_required_at IS NULL
AND dispatch_lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND dispatch_lease_owner IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign_delivery_event (workspace_id, delivery_id, event_type, detail, provider_id, provider_event_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{deliveryId}, #{eventType}, #{detail}, #{providerId}, #{providerEventId})
